# Tamiz Drip

**Status: DRAFT** · world: [neutronstar](../lore/worlds/neutronstar.md) · kind: new · stage: space · id: `tamiz_drip`

## Niche

- **Habitat:** Crustal transition zone near neutron drip threshold (~4×10^11 g/cm³)
- **Diet:** Free neutrons from drip, latent heat from pasta phase boundaries
- **Active:** Periodic bursts during density fluctuations, rests during stable hydrostatic equilibrium
- **Predators:** none

## Body

Compact layered defect shells, ~0.3 μm diameter, high proton-tolerance (speculative)

**Temperament:** Solitary, meticulous, prone to lattice-fracture anxiety

- Inviting one to conjugate grants temporary proton immunity.
